# DOMPurify

`purify.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of DOMPurify 3.4.15:
https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/blob/3.4.15/dist/purify.min.js

The upstream license is in `DOMPurify-LICENSE`. Keep this pinned local copy updated
when reviewing https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories.
AI reports and chat use it after Markdown rendering; never insert unsanitized
model output into the document.
